name: meadow
coordinates: x across, z along, y up, origin at the centre of the playable area; Unity mirrors x like it does for the .glb files

regions.encoding: RGBA8, one channel per region in order (r first): (d / range + 1) / 2 with d the signed distance to the region's edge in metres at the texel's centre, negative inside; 1 where a channel has no region; rows from the highest z down

instances.encoding: see SDFPipeline/Levels/InstanceFile.cs: header (groups, prototypes, cell grid, per-cell first record and count), then 32-byte records (prototype u16, flags u16, position 3 × f32, yaw f32, scale f32, tint RGBA8, hash u32), sorted by cell
